$comment: Known, accepted npm audit advisories at high/critical severity.
Checked by scripts/audit-check.mjs, which FAILS CI on any high/critical
advisory NOT listed here — so new vulnerabilities break the build while
Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date. Entries that no longer
match anything are reported as stale so they get deleted rather than
silently widening the exception over time.
CURRENTLY EMPTY. Phase 3B upgraded Expo SDK 54 -> 57, which cleared all
four previously-accepted entries (image-size x2, postcss x2 — they came
from expo@54's build toolchain). The gate reported them as stale, which
is how they were found and removed. Any high/critical advisory now fails
CI until it is fixed or deliberately listed here.
The 14 findings that remain are all MODERATE and therefore below this
gate's threshold. They sit in @expo/* build tooling and expo-router's
query-string/decode-uri-component chain at the latest published SDK, so
there is no version to upgrade to; npm's suggested 'fixes' for them are
downgrades to expo@46 / expo-router@5 and are not real.
